title: feat: composition
body:
**Summary**

This PR currently adds support for Composition using a (currently not published yet) Composition API Client:
- new `compositionID` optional parameter when initializing InstantSearch (this PR)
- don't allow index widget when in composition mode #6459
- make composition compatible with vue #6458
- handle disjunctive facets #6485
- add searchForFacetValues #6489
- make composition work server-side + typing #6509 
- tests #6510
